task:
A worker node is in NotReady state. SSH into it and fix the issue so it returns to Ready.

  1. Identify the NotReady node:
     kubectl get nodes

  2. SSH into the node:
     ssh <node-name>

  3. Diagnose — check kubelet status:
     sudo systemctl status kubelet
     sudo journalctl -u kubelet -n 50 --no-pager

  4. Common causes and fixes:

     a) kubelet is stopped:
        sudo systemctl start kubelet
        sudo systemctl enable kubelet

     b) Wrong kubelet binary path (ExecStart points to wrong path):
        sudo find / -name kubelet -type f 2>/dev/null
        sudo vi /etc/systemd/system/kubelet.service.d/10-kubeadm.conf
        sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl restart kubelet

     c) Wrong kubeconfig path:
        Check --kubeconfig flag in kubelet args
        ls /etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf

     d) Disk or resource pressure: check df -h, free -m

  5. Verify from control plane:
     kubectl get nodes  (node should become Ready within ~60 seconds)
hints: systemctl status kubelet is always the first step on any node issue
journalctl -u kubelet -n 50 shows the actual error
After fixing, systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl restart kubelet
detailed_hints: If ExecStart binary path is wrong: sudo vi /usr/lib/systemd/system/kubelet.service or /etc/systemd/system/kubelet.service.d/10-kubeadm.conf
Find kubelet binary: which kubelet or find /usr -name kubelet
After every change to service files: systemctl daemon-reload first, then restart

validators.description: No node is in NotReady state
